name: Tokyo Night (Schematic)
description: Tokyo Night color theme for the KiCad schematic editor. PCB, 3D viewer and GerbView colors stay at KiCad defaults.
description_full:
A dark color theme for the KiCad schematic editor, built on the Tokyo Night palette by enkia (night variant, background #1a1b26).

The theme covers the schematic editor only. The PCB editor, 3D viewer and GerbView sections hold near-default KiCad colors.

After installing, select the theme in Preferences > Schematic Editor > Colors.
